report.title: Report
report.invalid: There is nothing to report from this link.

about.post: Moderators will see the post and decide what to do.
about.person: Moderators will look at this account.
about.inviter: The person who invited them stays hidden from you. Moderators can see who it is and look at the invites they made.
about.preview: Use this when a link preview shows something different from where the link really goes.
about.message: Moderators will see this message, and only this message: never the rest of the conversation.

report.anonymous: Only moderators see reports. Nobody is told who reported.
report.sent: Thank you. Moderators will look at it.

reasonHint.bot: Posts or likes that a program sends instead of a person.
reasonHint.impersonation: Using someone else's name or identity.
reasonHint.misleading_preview: The preview does not match the page the link opens.
reasonHint.csam: Moderators handle these first and never show the content to anyone.

blame.title: Blame inbox
blame.intro: Moderator actions against people you invited.
blame.introTip: Only actions a moderator confirmed show up here. Who reported it is never shown.
blame.empty: Nothing here. Nobody you invited has had a moderator act on them.
blame.item: {action, select, remove_post {A moderator removed a post by @{handle}, whom you invited.} suspend_user {A moderator suspended @{handle}, whom you invited.} other {A moderator took action on @{handle}, whom you invited.}}
blame.post: The post by @{handle}, as you saw it:

queue.title: Moderation queue
queue.membersOnly: Only moderators can see this page.
queue.intro: Reports, held images and signals, most urgent first.
queue.introTip: Suspending an account, reporting held images, releasing a hold and quarantining an invite tree need a second moderator within 24 hours.
queue.subject: About @{handle}
queue.inviter: {kind, select, genesis {(genesis account)} deleted {(invited by a deleted account)} other {(invited by @{handle})}}
queue.noContent: The content is never shown for this reason.
queue.twoPerson: A second moderator has to confirm this.
queue.started: Sent. A second moderator has to confirm it within 24 hours.
queue.awaitingMine: You started it, so another moderator has to confirm.
queue.quarantineHint: Everyone they invited, directly or not, goes back to probation for 30 days, and their invites pause for 30 days. A second time takes their invites away.
queue.message: The reported message, as the reporter saw it:
queue.messageRemoved: The reported message (since deleted), as the reporter saw it:

log.title: Moderation log
log.intro: Confirmed removals, suspensions and moderator changes, by day.
log.introTip: People you're connected to are named; everyone else has a stand-in name.
log.subject: Who
log.pseudonymHint: Someone outside your network. The same account always has the same stand-in name.

roles.title: Moderators and admins
roles.adminsOnly: Only admins can see this page.
roles.intro: Making someone a moderator or removing them asks you to confirm with your passkey, and every change goes into the public moderation log. Admins can only be added or removed from the server command line.
roles.removeConfirm: Remove @{handle} as moderator? They go back to being a member, and anything they were handling goes back to the queue.
roles.change: {action, select, grant_moderator {@{by} made @{handle} a moderator} revoke_moderator {@{by} removed @{handle} as moderator} grant_admin {@{handle} became an admin} other {@{by} changed the role of @{handle}}}

errors.action_invalid: That action does not fit this report.
errors.action_pending: An action is already waiting for a second moderator.
errors.no_subject: There is no account to act on.
errors.second_moderator_required: A different moderator has to confirm this.
errors.action_expired: The 24 hours ran out. Start again.
errors.subject_inactive: This account is already suspended or deleted.
errors.quarantine_threshold: Not enough accounts in this invite tree are confirmed bad yet.
errors.quarantine_active: This invite tree was quarantined less than 30 days ago.
errors.already_staff: They are already a moderator or an admin.
errors.admin_role: Admins can only be changed from the server command line.
errors.not_moderator: They are not a moderator anymore.

signal.cadence: Posting around the clock or like a machine
signal.similarity: Accounts posting nearly the same text
signal.invite_cluster: Several people invited by one account on the same network
signal.stepup: Asked to confirm with a passkey again and again

fact.posts: {count, plural, one {# post in a day} other {# posts in a day}}
fact.hours: {count, plural, one {active in # hour of the day} other {active in # different hours of the day}}
fact.accounts: {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} in this group
fact.inviter_marks: {count, plural, one {Their inviter invited # removed account recently} other {Their inviter invited # removed accounts recently}}
fact.subtree_confirmed: {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}} in this invite tree confirmed bad (quarantine at {k, number})

csam.noContent: The image is never shown. These are the scanner's match details.
csam.hint: File the report with NCMEC first, then enter its number. A second moderator confirms it.

awaiting.suspend_user: Waiting for a second moderator to confirm the suspension.
awaiting.dismiss: Waiting for a second moderator to confirm that this was a false match.
awaiting.quarantine_subtree: Waiting for a second moderator to confirm the quarantine of the invite tree.
awaiting.csam_report: Waiting for a second moderator to confirm report {ref}.

cosign.dismiss: Confirm that the held image was a false match
cosign.quarantine_subtree: Confirm the quarantine of the invite tree
